items.q: The interviewer mentions Charlie Shavers, but the interviewee (Vic Dickenson) does not respond or provide any personal anecdote or connection regarding Shavers in the provided text.

ctx.x: Ours was a different type of band. Ours was a more like a Swing...like a Jump-Swing thing, you know. Theirs was more intricate things. They were so nice! So nice they made...
I guess Charlie Shavers really did a lot of the writing.
I think so. Yes, I'm sure he did. He and the pianist...
